guitar.notes: Eddie Van Halen's homemade 'Frankenstrat' is among the most iconic guitars in rock history, extremely well documented.

tone.target: brown sound lead with harmonics and divebombs
tone.profile: brown sound lead with harmonics and divebombs
tone.summary: A tight, saturated signal chain using a Boost and Distortion to drive a UK 45 amp model, paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cab. Emphasis is placed on adding vibrato (Tremolo) and artificial harmonics/dive effects.
corrections: Replace fuzz with hot Marshall drive
Add harmonics and vibrato bar effects

blocks.purpose: Provide initial saturation and drive to push the amp into a hot Plexi-style breakup.
blocks.gap: The Boost module is used as an aggressive pre-drive, simulating the role of a Tube Screamer or similar high-gain boost without adding unnecessary low end.

blocks.purpose: Add aggressive saturation and harmonic content required for the 'hot saturated lead' tone.
blocks.gap: Using general Distortion to mimic Marshall/Plexi breakup, as specific models like Green OD or Blues OD might be too scooped or tame.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall/Plexi tone required for high-gain lead work.
Provide the classic British cabinet sound and necessary high-end articulation.
Enhance the upper mids and treble to achieve 'tight upper mids' and cut through the mix.
blocks.gap: Using EQ 2 for its ability to boost specific frequency ranges without muddying the sound, focusing on the midrange punch.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the 'tremolo bar dips' and vibrato effect crucial for this style of soloing.
blocks.gap: While a dedicated whammy/pitch shifter would be ideal, Tremolo is the best available module to simulate pitch modulation or dive effects in the allowed list.

blocks.purpose: Add space and sustain to the lead lines.
Add subtle ambience and depth without washing out the aggressive lead tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism for better articulation of high-gain lead tones.

proposals.reason: Enhance upper mids and articulation for aggressive soloing.
